intro.title: Undo/Redo
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple text editor that allows you to undo and redo changes to the text. You will learn how to manage application state history using an array to store past states and a pointer to track the current position. The main technologies involved are React for the user interface and TypeScript for type-safe state management. By the end, you'll understand how to implement a common feature that enhances user control in applications.
intro.usecase: The undo/redo pattern is essential in any application where users make sequential changes they might want to revise. In text editors like Google Docs or code editors like VS Code, undo/redo allows users to revert typing mistakes or experimental code changes. Design tools such as Figma and Photoshop rely heavily on this pattern for creative experimentation without fear of permanent errors. Even in form-heavy applications like CRM systems or admin dashboards, undo/redo gives users confidence when editing multiple fields before submission.
